meta.title: Babkin Receptár
meta.description: Jednoduchá aplikácia s receptami pre babku: veľké písmo, zoznam jedál, suroviny a postup na odškrtávanie, naposledy použité navrchu. Recepty sa aktualizujú samy.

meta.title: Muzza Desktop
meta.tagline: Muzza for Windows and Linux: offline music player with the water theme and built-in downloader
meta.description: Muzza for computers. Windows: download Muzza-Desktop-1.0.0-windows-x64.zip, unzip it, run Muzza.exe (if Windows says 'Windows protected your PC', click More info, then Run anyway). Linux: unpack the tar.gz and run ./muzza (./install-linux.sh adds it to the app menu). Everything is inside: no Java or ffmpeg to install. Plays the songs in your Music folder; downloads go to Music/Muzza. Updates itself with one click.

meta.title: Muzza
meta.tagline: Offline music player for Android: no ads, no account, safe built-in downloader
meta.whatsNew: Dark water, fish icon and updates from inside the app
meta.description: An offline music player for Android with no ads, no account and no Wi-Fi needed. It plays the music already on the phone, with playlists, a queue, sleep timer, equalizer and speed controls. A built-in downloader searches YouTube or SoundCloud, or takes a pasted link, and saves songs with cover art to Music/Muzza. Version 1.2.0 adds dark water, a fish icon and updates from inside the app. For a phone, download the arm64 file; x86_64 is only for emulators.

meta.title: Slowwave
meta.description: Plays soft 50 ms pink noise bursts during the first hours of sleep. It is a self-experiment based on an MIT study in which pink noise bursts timed to deep-sleep slow waves made those waves, and the CSF flow that follows them, stronger.

meta.title: Questboard
meta.tagline: Game-themed quest board for Windows and Android, quests stay as Markdown on your PC
meta.description: A game-themed quest board for Windows and Android that opens when Windows starts and updates itself from its releases. Quests are plain Markdown on your own PC; completing one gives XP and level-ups, with Tavern and Abyss themes. An optional small sync server shares one board between PC, phone and other devices.

meta.title: IR Brute Remote
meta.tagline: Universal IR remote for a USB-C IR dongle: tap a button, it fires every matching code
meta.description: A universal IR remote for Android that works with a cheap USB-C IR dongle, the phone's own IR blaster, or an audio-jack IR dongle. Pick a device type and brand (both optional), tap a button, and it fires every matching code until the device reacts. Brute Setup walks through every button of a device and saves the codes that work.

meta.title: Nuvo Courier
meta.tagline: Courier app for the Nuvo box self-hosted ordering and delivery system
meta.description: The courier app of Nuvo box, a self-hosted ordering and delivery system for one business, run on the business's own server. Couriers sign in to the business's box to start delivering.

meta.title: Nuvo Storefront
meta.tagline: Customer ordering app for the Nuvo box self-hosted ordering and delivery system
meta.description: The customer app of Nuvo box, a self-hosted ordering and delivery system for one business: browse the menu, fill a cart and order, with delivery priced by address. It needs the business's Nuvo server to show a menu.

meta.title: DAB
meta.tagline: Friends-only location sharing with a fog-of-war exploration map
meta.description: A private, friends-only location sharing app with a fog-of-war exploration map: the map clears as you explore. You pair with friends by QR code or link, drop pins on places, and the map keeps working offline. The download comes in two builds: DAB and DAB Messenger (com.mildsolvent.dabmessenger).

meta.title: Jobler
meta.tagline: Job search that plays like a game: build a persona, forge a CV, let AI apply for you
meta.description: A job search that plays like a game. You build a persona through short, playful conversations with guild characters, forge a CV and collect cards in a binder. Later an AI applies on your behalf, paid for with credits called Sparks.
